subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup, and which callback or token handoff is acceptable for users who want instant setup with ChatGPT subscriptions?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but accepting callback URLs or OAuth material through env/config changes the auth-provider security boundary and cannot be safely selected by automation.

options.title: Design safer provider-owned handoff
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a provider-owned callback/token import contract with PKCE/state validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

options.title: Accept callback URL env contract
options.body: Implement the requested env-style callback URL import directly with strict validation and documentation, accepting the extra exposure risk as product policy.

options.title: Defer to existing flows
options.body: Keep browser, device-code, and API-key setup as the supported automation surfaces until upstream Codex exposes a stable external-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Design safer provider-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a provider-owned callback/token import contract with PKCE/state validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The non-interactive provider setup and OpenAI provider consolidation history both route the product/security shape to this area owner signal.
